aiOverview.content: Bryan Adams has announced an extensive "Roll With The Punches" world tour for 2026, which includes a major U.S. summer arena leg featuring special guests Pat Benatar & Neil Giraldo. The tour supports his 2025 album Roll With The Punches.2026 U.S. "Roll With The Punches" Tour Dates (Select Highlights)The tour spans major US cities from late July through mid-August 2026, featuring stops in St. Louis (July 24), Wichita (July 25), Thackerville (July 26), Austin (July 28), Houston (July 29), New Orleans (July 31), Orlando (Aug 5), and concluding in Milwaukee (Aug 16).Other 2026 Tour HighlightsLas Vegas Residency: "Bare Bones" acoustic shows at Encore Theater at Wynn Las Vegas in early June 2026.Canada Tour: Commencing late August 2026 in Quebec with guest artist Lights.International: Dates in South Africa, Europe, and Japan are scheduled.Something went wrong with this response.
